verdicts.why: Josie serves Matt, Foggy and Karen at her bar as they watch the report of the Punisher's arrest and toast (Penny and Dime, S2E4).
In .380 (S2E11) Daredevil subdues the guards at Gao's Chinatown dry-cleaner front and questions her; she says the Blacksmith's pure heroin comes in by ship.
In Dogs to a Gunfight (S2E2) Matt brings Melvin the helmet the Punisher shot; Melvin says it is compromised and he must make a new one, patches it for the night, and later delivers the new helmet.
The Man in the Box (S2E10): Matt visits Fisk at Rikers, accuses him of helping Castle escape and threatens to keep Vanessa out; Fisk breaks his bonds and slams Matt's head into the table.
New York's Finest (S2E3): Foggy finds Claire at Metro-General, helps with a patient, she checks records (Matt not treated anywhere) and says Matt can take care of himself.
Leap (S6E10): Mack and Daisy are cleared by his secret about her paying Amanda Campbell, then Mack locks Daisy and Yo-Yo away so Izel cannot take the strongest.

Enoch's page (cited AoS613): in 1931 Enoch dresses the Coulson LMD for Daisy and Mack to boot, puts the start button on the table and leaves the room; he also helped the team escape the temple in the upgraded Zephyr.

The Sign (S6E12): the recreated Flint attacks Izel where Mack and Yo-Yo are cuffed; Deke frees them and they bring the hurt Flint to the Zephyr, where Piper takes him. Per item 25 the show treats the recreation as Flint (all his memories).

The only Coulson here is the Chronicom LMD switched on at the end of New Life; an LMD version is not Coulson for his ties (settled earlier: Coulson S7 LMD rejected; his file stays the real, dead Coulson), so Mack and Coulson do not deal with each other in S6.
Collision Course Part Two (S6E9): trapped in the truck, Deke cannot defuse the bomb and Daisy contains it with her powers as the truck hits the tower.
Leap (S6E10): Mack locks Daisy and Yo-Yo in a room; when the two confront Izel, Yo-Yo allows herself to be possessed (Wikipedia).
The Other Thing (S6E5): Enoch tells Atarah that endangering Simmons will motivate Fitz; Daisy and Simmons are appalled, Daisy quakes Atarah and her hunters and they flee.
The Other Thing (S6E5): Simmons surrenders to the Chronicoms so Daisy and her team can return to Earth.

value.title: Agents of S.H.I.E.L.D. S6#13
value.text: May follows Izel back through the portal and cuts her down before she can kill Daisy, then collapses in Daisy's arms.
value.on_a_card_about_b: Her trainer, who saves her from Izel and collapses in her arms.
value.on_b_card_about_a: Her trainee, who holds her after she cuts down Izel.

verdicts.why: The S6E11 argument is true, but the moment that matters most between them this season is New Life (S6E13): Izel nearly stabs Daisy, May strikes her down from behind, and May loses consciousness in Daisy's arms.

Same as item 8: Daisy switches on the Chronicom LMD, not Coulson; the LMD does not carry stages on the real Coulson's ties. The letter she reads in S6E11 is a message from the dead Coulson with no exchange.
Collision Course Part Two (S6E9): Mack, Yo-Yo, Davis and Jaco take the Quinjet to infiltrate the Lazy Comet and rescue Fitz and Simmons.
The Sign (S6E12): Deke teleports into the temple and gives Yo-Yo, Mack and Flint Sonic Barrier Cuffs so they can escape.
Collision Course Part One (S6E8): Deke rides with May and Daisy in Sarge's truck; they find the bomb and count on Deke to dismantle it.
Leap (S6E10): Deke catches Piper with the Shrike crystal, Izel leaves Piper for Deke; Piper says Deke was there when she woke and Deke says the last he saw was Piper.
The Sign (S6E12): the recreated Flint attacks Izel where Yo-Yo and Mack are cuffed; once freed they get the injured Flint to the Zephyr and Piper. Per item 25 he counts as Flint.
Collision Course Part Two (S6E9): Yo-Yo and Mack find Fitz and Simmons on the Lazy Comet and Jaco's portal brings them all back to Earth.
Collision Course Part Two (S6E9): Yo-Yo and Mack find Fitz and Simmons on the Lazy Comet and Jaco's portal brings them all back to Earth.
Collision Course Part Two (S6E9): at the Lighthouse celebration Yo-Yo and May discuss how troubled they are that Sarge looks exactly like Coulson.
The Sign (S6E12): Mack and Yo-Yo bring Flint aboard the Zephyr to Piper, who tends him and tells them Sarge is at the temple with May and Daisy; they have her fly Flint to safety.

No: the Chronicom LMD is not counted as Coulson on his ties (earlier ruling, Coulson S7 LMD rejected; the existing Daisy and Mack ties with Coulson carry no S7 stages). Items 8 and 14 are rejected accordingly.

verdicts.why: Yes: the recreation is made with all of Flint's memories, recognizes Mack and Yo-Yo at once, is called Flint and lives on as Flint (Coulson Academy), so the show treats him as the same Flint, matching the earlier svout_03 ruling; the Mack and Yo-Yo S6#12 stages (items 7 and 19) stand.
Leap (S6E10): Fitz tells May Izel wanted the Monoliths; Deke reminds May of the Fear Dimension and Fitz theorizes a creation Monolith made Sarge.
The Sign (S6E12): Piper flies to the temple with May, Daisy and Sarge; finding the Zephyr crippled, May orders Piper to stay and repair it for extraction.
Straighten It Out (LC S2E2): Bobby stays at the barbershop, Claire comes by and they talk about the daughter he left; he says he is there to protect Luke.
Wig Out (LC S2E3): Claire treats Cockroach after Luke's beating and says she called only Misty and an ambulance; Misty lets Luke leave before Tyler and Bailey arrive.
Soul Brother #1 (LC S2E1): Comanche draws his gun on Luke as he bursts into Mariah's office with the Judas bullet and warns her about Claire, and watches the warning.
The Main Ingredient (LC S2E10): Luke and Danny eat at Genghis Connie's Too; Connie offers more places to rent and Luke says he can't risk another being blown up.
The Creator (LC S2E11): a real 1980s flashback in Jamaica, young Cornell splashes Mariah in the pool, telling her to get in, while she tries to read.

I Get Physical (LC S2E4): Misty receives a letter from Danny and Colleen with Rand blueprints for a prosthetic arm and decides to try it. Danny is in this season (S2E10), and sending her the arm is him acting for her, not a mere mention.
All Souled Out (LC S2E5): Foggy represents Luke in Cockroach's lawsuit, says to avoid court, offers him the paid appearance and goes with him to Piranha Jones.
